metaBuilds.title: Physical-Def Skirmisher
metaBuilds.whyLine: Strongest meta core for 10s rotation damage, online around minute 21 — about 766 damage over a 10s rotation in the sim.
metaBuilds.optimizer: Optimizer sees 2.8× the 10s rotation damage: try Oathkeeper over Fire Blossom (sim-only — the popular pick may carry utility the sim can't see; test it).

matchups.gameplan: Survive the early checkpoints, concede even trades, and take over once your spike lands. Khaimera's main threat is Cull; bait it before you commit, and armor softens the trade.

counterSwap.line: Losing lane? Third item Warden's Faith instead of Wraith Leggings: their burst combo hits 34% less hard, and this kit gives up 22% of its damage for it.
